content.short: Holyheld is a non-custodial account with a debit card and personal IBAN for spending onchain funds anywhere.
content.description: Holyheld turns a self-custody wallet into a spending account, pairing a personal IBAN for SEPA transfers with virtual and physical debit cards that work with Apple Pay and Google Pay. Cards come in Classic, Limited Edition and Metal tiers for a one time fee, and purchases earn between 0.5 and 1 percent back in USDC. The account reaches across more than 20 networks and 1,200 tokens, so funds can be spent or cashed out without bridging first, and cashing in works the same way in reverse. Holyheld also sells the underlying rails as an SDK to businesses that want to add on and off ramps.
content.meta: Holyheld is a non-custodial account with a debit card and personal IBAN across 20+ networks. Discover Holyheld and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
